# `ScopeMoveRound`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

End-of-round notification from the scope move-round worker, carrying only a success/fail result.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER (observation only) |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, scopeMoveRoundThreadFunc @0x119e40 (64-bit build); move step scopeMoveRound @0x184160 (sends the CompassCalibration events) |

Custom producer: sent once when the move-round worker thread ends (READ). That this worker is the thread started by start_scope_move_round is INFERRED from the function names; the start wrapper starts a thread object whose entry function is not visible in it. It carries no state, lapse_ms, code or error member. Progress and failure codes (241, 300, 320) of the move step are reported separately through CompassCalibration events (READ); a client SHOULD watch both. Channel I (TCP 4700). Delivery: ordinary broadcast to every retained socket of the emitting server (master, guest and never-verified sockets alike); no cadence, delivery or ordering guarantee relative to RPC replies or other events. No APK consumer is established.

Side effects: Observation only for the receiver.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"ScopeMoveRound"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `result` | string | yes | - | Literal from the worker's end branch. One of: `success`, `fail`. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, success - Round finished (READ shape; values invented):

```json
{"Event":"ScopeMoveRound","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","result":"success"}
```
